notes:
Shows Release Notes immediately after every successful Adult TV Test self-update, including updates triggered from IPTV playback, and marks them as seen so they are not shown again on the next Site start.

Adds a permanent Release Notes tab to the Custom Site Settings where the latest installed changes can be reviewed at any time.

Improves Simple IPTV Prüfen so the progress window is recreated for every tested channel, matching the Senderstatus prüfen workflow more closely.

Replaces the large IPTV benchmark result dialog with a compact Kodi notification and includes the names of failed channels directly in the result.

Makes Simple IPTV Update safer by removing the live TV/EPG database rotation step. Adult IPTV is now disabled, IPTV Simple is reloaded with the configured M3U/EPG sources and cache settings, and the PVR channel state is verified afterwards without intentionally restarting Kodi.

Keeps the existing streaming, resolver, playlist, thumbnail, Landscape Wall and update-check behavior otherwise unchanged from v1.92.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
